description: This Java class 'SOAPClientEngine' provides a client implementation for invoking SOAP-based web services within the Apache OFBiz framework. It extends 'GenericAsyncEngine' and implements synchronous and asynchronous invocation methods, configuring Axis2 client settings, constructing SOAP requests from service parameters, sending requests, and processing responses.

classes.name: SOAPClientEngine
classes.description: A final class that provides SOAP client capabilities for invoking web services, extending the 'GenericAsyncEngine' class and implementing methods to execute synchronous and asynchronous service calls with SOAP payloads.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Overrides 'runSyncIgnore' to invoke the service without returning results, internally calling 'runSync'.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Overrides 'runSync' to execute the service synchronously and return a result map, throwing an error if the result is null.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Private method that constructs and sends a SOAP request to a remote service using Axis2, processes the response, and returns a map of results or throws an exception on failure.
